chunks: "He is not from us who does not believe in our return and does not consider our mut'ah lawful."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.بِكَرَّتِنَا: in our return; i.e., the raj'ah

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about belief in raj'ah and the lawfulness of mut'ah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that belief in the raj'ah (return) and affirming the lawfulness of mut'ah are among the defining teachings associated with the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It presents both a creedal and legal marker of adherence to their path.
